author: KEXP
description: Southern California's Joyce Manor are a burst of pop-punk energy in our latest in-studio session. With buzzing guitars and punchy rhythms, the band offer a live performance of "I Know Where Mark Chen Lives" and more.
title: Joyce Manor performs "I Know Where Mark Chen Lives" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:

Grey Guitar 00:25

Well, Don't It Seem Like You've Been Here Before? 08:08
